statement: SELECT service, name, value, change_id, delay_ns FROM metrics JOIN deployments ON service = service WHERE name LIKE '%latency%' AND change_id != '' ORDER BY delay_ns LIMIT 20
logical_plan:
Sink
  Limit 20
    Sort [delay_ns]
      Project [service, name, value, change_id, delay_ns]
        Filter Binary { left: Binary { left: Column("name"), op: Like, right: Literal(Text("%latency%")) }, op: And, right: Binary { left: Column("change_id"), op: NotEq, right: Literal(Text("")) } }
          TemporalJoin deployments lookback=5000000000ns lookahead=10000000000ns
            Scan metrics [*]
